scope: dianoia BF16-to-Q4 language quantization; 153 Q4 matrices, tied output head Q8; unchanged vision weights and CPU encoder. Not QAD GGUF. No phone validation.
method: One fresh AOT process per backend/format, sequential GPU Q8/Q4 then CPU Q8/Q4; 7 paired cases; 3 fresh turns and 1 ungraded visual-context follow-up per case; 512 context, 32 max generated tokens, 4 native threads; no system prompt. Input bytes, source hashes and executable hash match. Short replies and one process per configuration limit performance conclusions.
